tools.name: regi_list_phone_numbers
tools.description: List the WhatsApp Business phone numbers of the Regi account. Each `id` is the phoneNumberId that regi_send_template needs. Use this first when you do not know the phoneNumberId.

tools.name: regi_list_templates
tools.description: List the WhatsApp message templates of the Regi account with name, language, category and status. Only templates with status APPROVED can be sent. The componentsJson field shows how many {{n}} variables the body expects.

tools.name: regi_send_template
tools.description: Send one approved WhatsApp template to one recipient. This bills per message and reaches a real person. Regi blocks a second send of a template to the same recipient within 2 hours until the recipient replies (HTTP 400); this tool does not bypass that block. Values in body_parameters fill {{1}}, {{2

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: regi_list_templates · Public sink: regi_send_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: regi_list_templates · Public sink: regi_send_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
